meta.purpose: Sanitized UserPromptSubmit harness/human fixtures for Phase 360 (room-bind picker fires on harness turns). Every entry, sequence and policy_entry here is authored placeholder data driving scripts/intent-classifier.cjs through spawn-kit.cjs; none of it is copied from any live transcript, snapshot, or intercept log. Plans 04 and 05 drive the hook against this data; this plan (360-02) only defines it and the R4/R8/R9 tripwire.
meta.sanitization_statement: Every text value in this file is authored for this corpus, following the tests/fixtures/card-fire-corpus-238.json convention. No real person name, no real organization name, no real email address, no session UUID from any live Claude Code transcript, and no peer unix-domain-socket path appears anywhere in this file. The stored-peer anchor shape from 357 RESEARCH Finding 3 (the session that minted the anchor false block) is reconstructed structurally only: the leading framing text and the tag that follows it, never the anchor's own conversational content, and never its session id or timestamp. Room names (copper-ledger, tin-orchard, quantum-bakery) are the same authored placeholders already committed in tests/test-260917-binding-gate-offscope.cjs; session ids and the one peer name are the sample- placeholders named below. The grep patterns run against this file to confirm no real-name/UUID/socket-path token leaked in are recorded in tests/test-360-tripwire.cjs legs r8b and r8c, and their pass/fail status is recorded in 360-02-SUMMARY.md.

placeholders.session_ids: every stdin.session_id in this file matches ^sample-session-[a-z0-9-]+$
placeholders.rooms_note: Rooms deliberately do NOT carry a shared 'sample-' prefix: scoreRoom (scripts/intent-classifier.cjs) awards +5 for a room-name token found in the message, so a shared token in every room name (and in the 'sample-peer' placeholder) would score every room at once and break the zero-score and off-scope legs. These three names are the same authored placeholders already committed in tests/test-260917-binding-gate-offscope.cjs, carrying no real content.

meta.ups_stdin_note: UserPromptSubmit stdin carries no origin and no isMeta field (360-RESEARCH Finding 1, confirmed against Claude Code 2.1.281 in tests/fixtures/ups-harness-360/pre-phase.json a1_check), so every entry here is prompt-only: the harness/human distinction is expressed purely through the LEAD text of stdin.prompt, per D-02's lead-only reduction.

accepted_limits.reason: The lead-only verdict cannot distinguish a human who pastes a harness tag as the first characters of their own typed message from a genuine harness turn. RESEARCH Finding 3/4 measured 0 of 2,154 human-origin prompts in the 30-day census leading with any of the five harness leads, so this is an accepted limit, not a defect: CONTEXT D-04's transcript-tail veto is superseded (see accepted-limit-pasted-lead entry below).
